title: Blend Train
shareTitle: Blend Train 🚂 — Sound Cars & Word Blending
description: Push sound cars together on the track, hear each sound spoken by the teacher voice, then hear the whole train blend into a word. A playful phonics ride for ages 5-6.
learningGoals: Blend onset and rime chunks into a word (m + at)
Blend a word sound by sound (m + a + t)
Notice that the vowel is a different kind of sound from the consonants
interactionModel: build-assemble: drag or tap-tap sound cars onto couplings along the track, left to right in reading order
feedbackModel: Coupled cars lock on, sparkle and speak their own recorded sound; a wrong coupling wiggles gently and glides the car home with a spoken nudge, never a failure. A finished train blends the sounds slowly and then celebrates the word.
